info.name: Foreign Exchange Rates CTP Checkout API API

items.docs: Initiates a Click to Pay checkout session for a consumer transaction. This operation creates a checkout context that allows the consumer to select from their stored payment credentials and complete the purchase.

params.name: checkoutId
params.description: Unique identifier for the checkout session

items.docs: Retrieves the current status and details of an existing Click to Pay checkout session identified by the checkout ID.
